description.value: Crave Cheesesteaks is a downtown Vancouver restaurant specializing in Philly-inspired cheesesteaks made fresh to order using 100% sirloin steak, real provolone and cheddar, and house-made sauces. Located at Robson and Richards, steps from BC Place, Rogers Arena, and the Vancouver Public Library, it serves a compact menu of steak, chicken, and jackfruit cheesesteaks in 8-inch and 12-inch sizes. Dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery are all available, making it a practical mid-ride fuel stop in the heart of the city.
